english: Switching to NVIDIA needs a restart this session: NR started before NVIDIA's runtime. Save as default, then restart Skyrim.
chinese: 本次游戏中切回 NVIDIA 需要重启：NR 早于 NVIDIA 运行时启动。请保存为默认，然后重启 Skyrim。

english: Provider change pending; waiting for world inputs...
chinese: 提供商切换待生效；正在等待世界输入……

english: Takes effect immediately. Save as default to keep this choice for the next launch.
chinese: 立即生效。选择“保存为默认”可在下次启动时保留此选择。

english: Waiting for the current GPU frame to retire...
chinese: 正在等待当前 GPU 帧结束……

english: NVIDIA host is unavailable. Check runtime status and restart Skyrim.
chinese: NVIDIA 宿主不可用。请检查运行时状态并重启 Skyrim。

english: x2 is Intel's official mode. x3-x6 patch Intel's runtime in memory and are experimental. The first Apply to x3-x6 recreates the Intel presenter; later multiplier changes apply live.
chinese: x2 是 Intel 的官方模式。x3-x6 会在内存中修补 Intel 运行时，属于实验性功能。首次点击“应用”切换到 x3-x6 时会重建 Intel 呈现器；之后的倍率更改实时生效。

english: x2 is Intel's official mode. The experimental x3-x6 patch Intel's runtime in memory and need the Universal edition installed below Standard; a saved x3-x6 runs at x2.
chinese: x2 是 Intel 的官方模式。实验性 x3-x6 会在内存中修补 Intel 运行时，需要在 Standard 之下安装 Universal 版；已保存的 x3-x6 将以 x2 运行。

english: A saved dynamic request is unsupported by this NVIDIA runtime.
chinese: 此 NVIDIA 运行时不支持已保存的动态请求。

english: 0 = display refresh rate; explicit targets must exceed 60 FPS.
chinese: 0 = 使用屏幕刷新率；指定目标必须超过 60 FPS。

english: NVIDIA reports its supported multipliers once DLSS-G is running.
chinese: NVIDIA 在 DLSS-G 运行后报告其支持的倍率。

english: Saved/requested MFG is unsupported here. The runtime uses the supported count; your requested preference is retained.
chinese: 此环境不支持已保存/请求的 MFG。运行时会使用受支持的帧数；你请求的偏好已被保留。

english: Generates the scene and HUD separately to reduce HUD ghosting in motion. Small GPU and VRAM cost. Apply to compare live.
chinese: 将场景与 HUD 分开生成，以减少运动中的 HUD 残影。GPU 与显存开销较小。点击应用即可实时对比。

english: NVIDIA's Frame Generation presets. A interpolates the HUD with the scene. B generates the scene and HUD separately for less HUD ghosting in motion, at a small GPU and VRAM cost. C uses NVIDIA's lighter Lite blending (DLSS-G 310.9.16 or newer) without UI recomposition. Apply to compare live.
chinese: NVIDIA 的帧生成预设。A 将 HUD 与场景一起插值。B 将场景与 HUD 分开生成，以减少运动中的 HUD 残影，GPU 与显存开销较小。C 使用 NVIDIA 更轻量的 Lite 混合（需要 DLSS-G 310.9.16 或更高版本），不做 UI 重新合成。点击应用即可实时对比。

english: Preset C is checked when DLSS-G loads
chinese: DLSS-G 加载时会检测预设 C

english: This DLSS-G build has no Preset C; it runs as Preset A
chinese: 此 DLSS-G 构建没有预设 C；将以预设 A 运行

english: NVIDIA driver profile sets Preset %s; DLSS-G uses it instead
chinese: NVIDIA 驱动配置强制预设 %s；DLSS-G 会改用该预设

english: Waiting for HUD-less and UI layers
chinese: 等待 HUD-less 与 UI 图层
向 XeFG 发送帧时间##sourceDLSSG

english: Gives Intel's frame pacing the measured frame time. On AMD and NVIDIA cards Intel uses it to sanity-check pacing. Apply to compare live.
chinese: 将实测帧时间提供给 Intel 的帧节奏控制。在 AMD 和 NVIDIA 显卡上，Intel 用它来校验帧节奏。点击应用即可实时对比。

english: The cap includes generated frames. Avoid stacking it with another limiter.
chinese: 该上限包含生成的帧。请避免与其他帧率限制器叠加使用。

english: XeFG uses XeLL. NVIDIA multiplier and Reflex preferences are retained.
chinese: XeFG 使用 XeLL。NVIDIA 倍率与 Reflex 偏好会被保留。

english: Game-rendered scene.\nClick to open Image settings.
chinese: 游戏渲染的画面。\n点击打开画面设置。

english: Upscaling is controlled in the Community Shaders menu.\nClick to open Image status.
chinese: 放大由 Community Shaders 菜单控制。\n点击查看画面状态。

english: DLSS or XeSS reconstruction, or native-resolution DLAA.\nClick to open Image settings.
chinese: DLSS 或 XeSS 重建，或原生分辨率 DLAA。\n点击打开画面设置。

english: Adds generated frames between game-rendered frames.\nClick to open Frame generation settings.
chinese: 在游戏渲染的帧之间插入生成的帧。\n点击打开帧生成设置。

english: Final output resolution.\nClick to open Image settings.
chinese: 最终输出分辨率。\n点击打开画面设置。

english: Expands the finished SDR image (including ENB) to HDR10 and shows the UI at its own brightness. Highlights the preset already clipped cannot be recovered. Requires Windows HDR. The first switch on in a session briefly pauses frame generation.
chinese: 将最终的 SDR 画面（包括 ENB）扩展为 HDR10，UI 以独立亮度显示。预设中已被裁剪的高光无法找回。需要 Windows HDR。本次游戏中首次开启时会短暂暂停帧生成。
点击“应用”以%s HDR 输出

english: HDR output off; 10-bit output stays allocated until restart
chinese: HDR 输出已关闭；10 位输出将保留至重启

english: Output pass GPU: %.2f ms average, %.2f ms max
chinese: 输出通道 GPU 耗时：平均 %.2f ms，峰值 %.2f ms
跟随 Windows SDR 亮度##hdr

english: Paper white and UI: %.0f nits from Windows
chinese: 纸白与 UI：跟随 Windows 的 %.0f 尼特

english: Windows SDR brightness unavailable; using the values below
chinese: 无法获取 Windows SDR 亮度；改用下方数值

english: Uses Windows' SDR content brightness (Settings > Display > HDR) for paper white and UI, so whites match the desktop. Untick to set them here.
chinese: 将 Windows 的 SDR 内容亮度（设置 > 显示 > HDR）用于纸白与 UI，使白色与桌面观感一致。取消勾选可在此手动设置。

english: Brightness of SDR white in the scene. Start near the Windows SDR content brightness.
chinese: 场景中 SDR 白色的亮度。建议从接近 Windows SDR 内容亮度的值开始。

english: Brightest expanded highlight. Set to your display's peak.
chinese: 扩展后最亮的高光。建议设为显示器的峰值亮度。

english: 0 keeps the SDR range at paper white; 1 expands the brightest pixels to peak brightness.
chinese: 0 保持 SDR 范围不超过纸白亮度；1 将最亮的像素扩展到峰值亮度。

english: SDR brightness where expansion begins. Higher values boost only the brightest areas.
chinese: 开始扩展的 SDR 亮度。数值越高，仅最亮的区域得到提升。

english: How the SDR image is decoded. Gamma 2.2 matches most SDR monitors; sRGB lifts shadows.
chinese: SDR 画面的解码方式。Gamma 2.2 适合大多数 SDR 显示器；sRGB 会提亮阴影。

english: Community Shaders controls upscaling, render scale, model preset, sharpening and camera jitter. Change those settings in its menu.
chinese: Community Shaders 控制放大、渲染比例、模型预设、锐化与相机抖动。请在它的菜单中修改这些设置。

english: TRP's Neural Rendering, frame generation and Reflex controls remain available in their own tabs.
chinese: TRP 的神经渲染、帧生成与 Reflex 控件仍在各自标签页中可用。

english: Use Community Shaders' HDR Display for HDR with Community Shaders.
chinese: 搭配 Community Shaders 时，HDR 请使用其 HDR Display 功能。

english: DLSS / XeSS: Apply; render scale: restart
chinese: DLSS / XeSS：点击应用；渲染比例：需重启
模式 / 比例：需保存并重启

english: Apply switches DLSS/XeSS at the current render size when the SDK accepts it and NVIDIA host services are ready. Render scale and DLAA changes require restart. Other startup paths require restart to enter DLSS. After restart, XeSS uses Intel's quality resolutions.
chinese: 当 SDK 接受且 NVIDIA 宿主服务就绪时，点击应用会以当前渲染尺寸切换 DLSS/XeSS。渲染比例与 DLAA 更改需要重启。其他启动路径需要重启才能进入 DLSS。重启后，XeSS 使用 Intel 的画质分辨率。

english: Live switch unavailable; selected mode requires restart
chinese: 无法实时切换；所选模式需要重启
模式/渲染比例等待重启后生效
功能更新失败；需要重启

english: {}\nRequested preset; NVIDIA chooses the actual model. L/M require a supporting runtime.
chinese: {}\n为请求的预设；NVIDIA 会决定实际使用的模型。L/M 需要受支持的运行时。

english: Set in the Neural Rendering tab. Applies with or without NR.
chinese: 在“神经渲染”页设置。无论是否开启 NR 均生效。

english: XeSS preserves the SDR exposure supplied by the game and ENB.
chinese: XeSS 保留游戏与 ENB 提供的 SDR 曝光。
仅对之后的纹理加载生效
启用运行时 Mip 上限

english: The provider started without hooks. Save the startup default and relaunch to enable texture interception.
chinese: 提供方启动时未安装钩子。请保存启动默认值并重新启动，以启用纹理拦截。
文件夹规则：见 TextureDownscaler 菜单

english: Existing textures stay unchanged until reloaded. Folder rules and exclusions are in TextureDownscaler's Menu Framework page.
chinese: 已有纹理在重新加载前保持不变。文件夹规则与排除项位于 TextureDownscaler 的 Menu Framework 页面。

english: Drag to resize columns. Save as default remembers the layout.
chinese: 拖动可调整两栏宽度。选择“保存为默认”可记住布局。

english: Neural Rendering requires NVIDIA RTX hardware. XeSS upscaling and XeFG remain available.
chinese: 神经渲染需要 NVIDIA RTX 硬件。XeSS 放大和 XeFG 仍然可用。

english: NR runtime path is empty. Configure NeuralRenderingRuntimePath in TheosRenderPipeline.ini and restart Skyrim.
chinese: NR 运行时路径为空。请在 TheosRenderPipeline.ini 中配置 NeuralRenderingRuntimePath 并重启 Skyrim。

english: NR runtime DLL not found. Install the optional nvngx_dlssnr.dll at the path below and restart Skyrim.
chinese: 未找到 NR 运行时 DLL。请将可选的 nvngx_dlssnr.dll 安装到以下路径并重启 Skyrim。

english: The NVIDIA host is not ready. Check runtime status and restart Skyrim.
chinese: NVIDIA 宿主尚未就绪。请检查运行时状态并重启 Skyrim。

english: NR failed. See the error in the left column.
chinese: NR 已失败。请查看左栏中的错误信息。

english: NR requires DLSS or DLAA mode. Select either in Image and restart Skyrim.
chinese: NR 需要 DLSS 或 DLAA 模式。请在“画面”页选择其一并重启 Skyrim。

english: NR requires dedicated UI composition. Set NativeUICompositionMode=0 in the INI and restart Skyrim. If it is already 0, check the log for a composition failure.
chinese: NR 需要专用 UI 合成。请在 INI 中设置 NativeUICompositionMode=0 并重启 Skyrim。如果已经是 0，请在日志中查找合成失败的记录。
无当前帧分类；使用普通 NR

english: 0 preserves the original object; 1 applies the full NR result. Applies after both passes, before UI composition. Experimental opaque-object capture for Skyrim 1.6.1170; transparent/alpha-tested or unclassified pixels keep normal NR. This does not reduce inference cost.
chinese: 0 保留原始对象；1 应用完整的 NR 结果。在两遍处理后、UI 合成前生效。适用于 Skyrim 1.6.1170 的实验性不透明对象捕获；透明/Alpha 测试或无法分类的像素保持普通 NR。这不会降低推理开销。

english: One pass while weapons are drawn

chinese: 自动 | 重建缩小的输入
残差 | 叠加 NR 变化
比值 | 传递光照与色彩

english: Both passes use the selected side of upscaling. UI is composed afterwards.
chinese: 两遍处理都使用所选的放大一侧。UI 会在之后合成。
! 更改后会短暂重启 NR
处理遍数  |  正在编辑 {}

english: Pass 2 processes Pass 1's result with separate history and adds GPU time and memory. Presets switch it on and off without restarting NR.
chinese: 第 2 遍以独立历史处理第 1 遍的结果，会增加 GPU 时间与显存占用。预设可以开关第 2 遍而无需重启 NR。

english: Changing a Pass 2 setting gives it its own settings, starting from Pass 1's.
chinese: 更改第 2 遍的任意设置后，它会拥有自己的设置，初始值取自第 1 遍。

english: Pass 2 follows Pass 1 again. Its own settings are kept for later.
chinese: 第 2 遍重新跟随第 1 遍。其独立设置会保留供以后使用。

english: -1 follows local structure. Ctrl-click a slider to type.
chinese: -1 表示跟随局部结构。Ctrl+点击滑块可直接输入数值。
CS 在 NR 之后绘制 UI

english: Relative to the selected stage's scene size. Apply to update.
chinese: 相对于所选阶段场景的大小。应用后更新。

english: Default runs the runtime's newest network. Previous model runs the 310.8 network, which 310.9.16 also includes.
chinese: “默认”运行运行时中最新的网络。“上一模型”运行 310.8 网络，310.9.16 也包含该网络。
锐化由 Community Shaders 控制

english: Temporarily skips Pass 2 when either selected condition is active. Keeps your NR resolution, tuning and saved two-pass setting. The image may change when switching.
chinese: 当任一所选条件激活时，暂时跳过第 2 遍。会保留你的 NR 分辨率、调参与已保存的两遍设置。切换时画面可能发生变化。

english: One pass while weapons are drawn
Waits this long after all selected conditions clear before restoring two passes. Pausing the game pauses the delay.
chinese: 所有所选条件解除后，等待此时长再恢复两遍。游戏暂停时计时也会暂停。

english: Preserves sampling density across the central 80% of each axis and compresses the edges. Uses about 19% fewer model pixels at the same input resolution. Inspect edge quality when moving.
chinese: 在每条轴中央 80% 的范围内保持采样密度，并压缩边缘。相同输入分辨率下约减少 19% 的模型像素。移动镜头时请留意边缘质量。

english: Combines colour encoding with downsampling where needed, and depth/motion packing with peripheral compression. Some configurations have no passes to combine. Applies to both passes.
chinese: 在需要时将颜色编码与降采样合并，并将深度/运动打包与外围压缩合并。某些配置没有可合并的遍次。对两遍均生效。

english: CS restores scene colour automatically before DLSS.
chinese: CS 会在 DLSS 之前自动还原场景颜色。

english: Residual clamps colour to 0..1. Use Ratio for linear HDR input.
chinese: 残差会把颜色限制在 0..1。线性 HDR 输入请使用比值。

english: Scene normalization sets the brightness range NR sees.
chinese: 场景归一化设定 NR 所看到的亮度范围。

english: White point for encoding linear HDR input before model evaluation.
chinese: 在模型评估前编码线性 HDR 输入所用的白点。

english: HDR input is used by Ratio reconstruction; it does not change the display HDR mode.
chinese: HDR 输入仅由比值重建使用；不会改变显示的 HDR 模式。

english: One pass while weapons are drawn

Automatic chooses the runtime for your GPU. Universal unlocks NVIDIA 310.9.16 on RTX 20/30/40; RTX 50 uses it natively. The kernel pack uses FP16 fallback on RTX 20/30 and FP8 on RTX 40. Legacy INT8 is an RTX 20/30 alternative. Hover an entry for its filename.
chinese: “自动”会为你的 GPU 选择运行时。Universal 在 RTX 20/30/40 上解锁 NVIDIA 310.9.16；RTX 50 原生使用它。内核包在 RTX 20/30 上使用 FP16 回退，在 RTX 40 上使用 FP8。旧版 INT8 是 RTX 20/30 的替代选项。将鼠标悬停在条目上可查看文件名。

english: Combined model inference and inter-pass preparation. Excludes input preparation, final Pass 2 restoration, reconstruction, UI composition and the D3D11/D3D12 handoff.
chinese: 包含模型推理与遍间预处理。不含输入准备、最终第 2 遍复原、重建、UI 合成以及 D3D11/D3D12 交接。
提交帧数 %llu | 历史重置 %llu

english: Inference max %.3f ms | %llu samples | %llu query failures
chinese: 推理最大 %.3f 毫秒 | %llu 采样 | %llu 查询失败

english: NVIDIA's presentation count; physical screen refreshes and scanout spacing are not measured.
chinese: NVIDIA 的呈现计数；物理屏幕刷新与扫描输出间隔不计入其中。

english: Game-facing Present cadence, before generated frames. This is not GPU execution time.
chinese: 面向游戏的 Present 节奏，在生成帧之前。这不是 GPU 执行时间。

english: Colour, guide and UI preparation before inference.
chinese: 推理前的颜色、引导与 UI 准备。

english: Pass 2 restoration, colour reconstruction, native UI composition and the HUD-less copy.
chinese: 第 2 遍复原、颜色重建、原生 UI 合成与无 HUD 复制。

english: Before-DLSS NR only: the input and result copies plus the waits between the two APIs.
chinese: 仅限 DLSS 前的 NR：输入与结果复制，以及两个 API 之间的等待。
GPU 计时不可用（查询失败）

english: GPU timing queries failed. Restarting the game retries timings; rendering continues.
chinese: GPU 计时查询失败。重启游戏会重试计时；渲染继续进行。

english: Enable stage timings in Advanced, then Apply.
chinese: 在“高级”页启用阶段计时，然后点击应用。

english: Copy or HDR encoding into the swapchain.
chinese: 复制或 HDR 编码到交换链。

english: Everything TRP records before Present: after-DLSS NR, output and XeFG input copies.
chinese: TRP 在 Present 前记录的全部内容：DLSS 后的 NR、输出与 XeFG 输入复制。

english: Rolling raster thresholds, not slow-frame averages or generated-frame cadence.
chinese: 滚动光栅阈值，不是慢帧平均值或生成帧节奏。
%u / 1024 帧；%llu 个 GPU 采样

english: DLSS-G's copies of the tagged inputs.
chinese: DLSS-G 对已标记输入的复制。

english: GPU time from the end of TRP's output to DLSS-G releasing this frame's inputs. It covers generating this frame's generated frames; other GPU work running at the same time can add to it.
chinese: 从 TRP 输出结束到 DLSS-G 释放本帧输入的 GPU 时间。它涵盖生成本帧的生成帧；同时运行的其他 GPU 工作可能使其增加。

english: Frame generation ms: p50 %.2f | p95 %.2f | p99 %.2f

chinese: %llu 次实测，%llu 次仅为上限

english: An upper bound is a frame where DLSS-G had already finished before TRP could measure it.
chinese: 上限表示 DLSS-G 在 TRP 能够测量之前就已完成该帧。

english: CPU Present ms: p50 %.2f | p95 %.2f | p99 %.2f
chinese: CPU Present 毫秒：p50 %.2f | p95 %.2f | p99 %.2f

english: CPU Present includes waits. Physical display cadence is not measured.
chinese: CPU Present 包含等待时间。不测量物理显示节奏。

english: On by default. Writes sharpened output directly, avoiding its final copy. Apply required.
chinese: 默认开启。直接写入锐化后的输出，省去最后一次复制。需要点击应用。

english: On by default. Avoids the DLSS copy when sharpening is off; does not disable sharpening. Apply required.
chinese: 默认开启。锐化关闭时省去 DLSS 复制；不会禁用锐化。需要点击应用。
非阻塞的 GPU/CPU 测量；需要点击应用。

english: Writes a .sfgtrace sidecar on a background thread; Apply required.
chinese: 在后台线程写入 .sfgtrace 附属文件；需要点击应用。
追踪：%s | 已写入 %llu | 已丢弃 %llu

english: Native-resolution menus and HUD join the processed scene before frame generation.\nThe diagram shows applied settings; controls below may contain unapplied edits.
chinese: 原分辨率菜单与 HUD 会在帧生成之前合入处理后的画面。\n图表显示已应用的设置；下方控件可能包含未应用的修改。

english: Changing this restarts NR briefly. A preset that changes it can hitch when the weather changes.
chinese: 更改此项会短暂重启 NR。若预设更改了此项，天气切换时可能出现卡顿。

english: Presets change Neural Rendering settings for the weather or places you choose. Everywhere else uses Base.
chinese: 预设会为你选择的天气或地点更改神经渲染设置。其他所有情况都使用 Base。
第 1 遍：强度 %.2f | 色调 %.2f | 结构 %.2f
第 2 遍：强度 %.2f | 色调 %.2f | 结构 %.2f

english: Uses Base right away, until you untick this or restart the game. Not saved.
chinese: 立即改用 Base，直到取消勾选或重启游戏。不会被保存。

english: Starts with no changes. Choose when it applies, then change the settings you want different from Base.
chinese: 新建时没有任何更改。选择它的生效条件，然后修改想要不同于 Base 的设置。

english: Copies the selected preset's changes. Choose when the copy applies.
chinese: 复制所选预设的更改。选择副本的生效条件。

english: When two presets use the same weather, the higher one wins.
chinese: 当两个预设使用同一天气时，列表中靠上的优先。

english: When each time of day starts, and how smoothly presets change.
chinese: 设置一天中各时段的开始时间，以及预设之间切换的平滑程度。

english: Softens changes between presets. Zero follows weather and time directly.
chinese: 柔化预设之间的切换。为 0 时直接跟随天气和时间。
各时段开始时间（游戏内小时）

english: Copied ENB clock markers and dawn/dusk boundaries. Review the times, then Apply.
chinese: 已复制 ENB 的时钟标记与黎明/黄昏边界。请检查这些时间，然后点击应用。

english: Could not derive an increasing 24-hour schedule from the game's enbseries.ini. Enter the times manually.
chinese: 无法从游戏的 enbseries.ini 推导出递增的 24 小时时间表。请手动输入时间。

english: Uses ENB's Night, Sunrise, Day and Sunset markers, plus Sunrise minus DawnDuration and Sunset plus DuskDuration. It does not reproduce ENB's internal phase weights or change ENB settings.
chinese: 使用 ENB 的 Night、Sunrise、Day、Sunset 标记，再加上 Sunrise−DawnDuration 与 Sunset+DuskDuration。不会重现 ENB 的内部相位权重，也不会更改 ENB 设置。

english: Times must increase from Night to Dusk. Presets blend between neighbouring times.
chinese: 各时段时间必须依次递增。预设会在相邻时段之间过渡。
取消勾选的预设会保留设置，但会被忽略。

english: Adds a copy with every setting stored, so it looks the same with anyone's Base. Share its file.
chinese: 添加一个存储全部设置的副本，在任何人的 Base 下外观都一致。可分享其文件。

english: Changed settings are amber. Everything else follows Base, including later Base edits.
chinese: 更改过的设置以琥珀色显示。其余全部跟随 Base，包括之后对 Base 的修改。

english: One pass while weapons are drawn
\"{}\" uses this{}. The higher preset in the list wins; move this one up to use it here.
chinese: “{}”已使用此条件{}。列表中靠上的预设优先；将本预设上移即可在此使用它。

english: Any outdoor weather not covered by a more specific preset.
chinese: 未被更具体的预设覆盖的任意户外天气。

english: \nNot loaded this session; kept for when its plugin returns.
chinese: \n本次会话未加载；保留以待其插件返回。

english: \n\"{}\" uses this instead; it is higher in the list.
chinese: \n“{}”已改用它；它在列表中更靠上。

english: Pick exact weathers, such as fog or ash, that the weather types above don't describe well.
chinese: 选择上面的天气类型无法准确描述的具体天气，例如雾或灰烬。

english: Specific weathers win over weather types, which win over Outdoors. If presets share one, the higher in the list wins.
chinese: 具体天气优先于天气类型，天气类型优先于户外。若多个预设使用同一天气，列表中靠上的优先。

english: Different look by time of day
chinese: 不同时段使用不同外观

english: Intensity, local tone, local structure and sharpening strength can differ at each time of day and blend between them. Other settings stay the same all day.
chinese: 强度、局部色调、局部结构与锐化强度可以在一天中各时段取不同值并在其间过渡。其他设置全天保持不变。
自 {} 起，{} 时开始过渡到 {}。{}

english: Pick a time to edit its look; it blends into the next. Green is now. Other settings stay the same all day.
chinese: 选择一个时段来编辑其外观；它会过渡到下一时段。绿色表示当前时段。其他设置全天保持不变。

english: Name, plugin, FormID or weather type
chinese: 名称、插件、FormID 或天气类型
已加载 %zu | 显示 %zu | 已选 %zu

english: Weather assignment limit reached; no assignments were changed.
chinese: 已达到天气指派上限；未更改任何指派。

english: A weather in several presets uses the highest one in the list. Names come from the game or an editor-ID plugin.
chinese: 同一天气出现在多个预设时，使用列表中靠上的预设。名称来自游戏或 editor-ID 插件。

english: Presets can switch NR or sharpening off, but not on while Base has them off.
chinese: 预设可以关闭 NR 或锐化，但在 Base 关闭它们时无法将其打开。

english: Where it applied, Base or another preset is used.\nSave as default deletes its preset file; Discard undoes this.
chinese: 它生效的地方会改用 Base 或其他预设。\n“保存为默认”会删除其预设文件；“放弃”可撤销此操作。

english: [ and ] are NR shortcuts while EnableNRHotkeys is on. Choose another key.
chinese: 启用 EnableNRHotkeys 时，[ 和 ] 是 NR 快捷键。请选择其他按键。

english: That key cannot open the menu. Choose another key.
chinese: 该按键不能用于打开菜单。请选择其他按键。

english: %s by 25%%. Save as default remembers the zoom.
chinese: 点击以%s 25%%。“保存为默认”会记住缩放。

english: Click to return to automatic zoom (%.0f%% for this output).
chinese: 点击恢复自动缩放（当前输出为 %.0f%%）。

english: Automatic zoom from the output height; 1080p is 100%%.
chinese: 根据输出高度自动缩放；1080p 为 100%%。

english: Discard edits you have not applied. Applied settings and saved defaults stay as they are.
chinese: 放弃尚未应用的修改。已应用的设置和已保存的默认值保持不变。

english: Apply live settings for this session. Saved defaults stay unchanged.\nMode and render scale changes require Save and restart.
chinese: 仅在本次游戏中应用实时设置,保存的默认值不变。\n模式与渲染比例的修改需要保存并重启后生效。

english: Apply live settings and save your choices, zoom, window layout and divider for future launches.\nMode and render scale changes take effect after restarting.
chinese: 应用实时设置并保存你的选择、缩放、窗口布局与分隔线位置,供下次启动使用。\n模式与渲染比例的修改将在重启后生效。
ReShade 效果已关闭：附加组件

english: is incompatible with TRP and would crash. To use ReShade, add
chinese: 与 TRP 不兼容并会导致崩溃。要使用 ReShade，请将
添加到 ReShade.ini 的 [ADDON] DisabledAddons 中

english: ReShade source-frame stage active; ReGrade+ device events bridged
chinese: ReShade 源帧阶段已激活；ReGrade+ 设备事件已桥接

english: ReShade public runtime exports unavailable; keeping automatic effects
chinese: ReShade 公开运行时导出不可用；保留自动效果
ReShade 拒绝了附加组件 API 14
ReShade 已在 ReShade.ini 中禁用

english: ReShade API 14 registered; waiting for source color
chinese: ReShade API 14 已注册；等待源颜色

english: ReShade native output isolated; waiting for source UI
chinese: ReShade 原生输出已隔离；等待源 UI

english: ReShade native output isolated; ReGrade+ device events bridged; waiting for source UI
chinese: ReShade 原生输出已隔离；ReGrade+ 设备事件已桥接；等待源 UI

english: ReShade native output ownership unavailable; keeping automatic effects
chinese: ReShade 原生输出所有权不可用；保留自动效果

english: Neural Rendering requires NVIDIA RTX hardware; XeSS and XeFG remain available.
chinese: 神经渲染需要 NVIDIA RTX 硬件；XeSS 与 XeFG 仍然可用。

english: NR runtime DLL not found. Install nvngx_dlssnr.dll at the configured path and restart Skyrim.
chinese: 未找到 NR 运行时 DLL。请将 nvngx_dlssnr.dll 安装到配置的路径并重启 Skyrim。

english: NR is unavailable after a runtime failure; turn NR off or restart Skyrim.
chinese: 运行时失败后 NR 不可用；请关闭 NR 或重启 Skyrim。

english: NR requires dedicated UI composition. Turn NR off to apply other changes, or set NativeUICompositionMode=0 in the INI and restart Skyrim.
chinese: NR 需要专用 UI 合成。请关闭 NR 以应用其他修改，或在 INI 中设置 NativeUICompositionMode=0 并重启 Skyrim。

english: NVIDIA host is unavailable; settings were not applied.
chinese: NVIDIA 宿主不可用；设置未应用。
请选择有效的面板快捷键。
请选择 DLSS、DLAA 或 XeSS。

english: DLSS/DLAA require NVIDIA RTX hardware. Select XeSS for this GPU.
chinese: DLSS/DLAA 需要 NVIDIA RTX 硬件。请为当前 GPU 选择 XeSS。

english: Preset times must increase from Night to Dusk and stay between 0 and 24 hours.
chinese: 预设各时段时间必须从 Night 到 Dusk 依次递增，并保持在 0 到 24 小时之间。

english: Dynamic target output FPS must be 0 or between 61 and 1000.
chinese: 动态目标输出 FPS 必须为 0 或在 61 到 1000 之间。

english: Choose NVIDIA DLSS-G or Intel XeFG.
chinese: 请选择 NVIDIA DLSS-G 或 Intel XeFG。

english: Settings draft is unavailable; reopen the menu.
chinese: 设置暂存不可用；请重新打开菜单。

english: Saved to TheosRenderPipeline.User.ini; updates keep these settings.
chinese: 已保存到 TheosRenderPipeline.User.ini；更新时会保留这些设置。

english: Could not write TheosRenderPipeline.User.ini; settings remain active for this session.
chinese: 无法写入 TheosRenderPipeline.User.ini；设置仅在本游戏中保持有效。

english: Source DLSS configuration failed; restart required.
chinese: 源 DLSS 配置失败；需要重启。

english: Mode/quality saved for restart; live feature changes apply after this frame.
chinese: 模式/画质已保存，重启后生效；实时功能更改将在本帧之后应用。

english: Mode/quality staged for restart; Save as default to keep them. Live feature changes are queued.
chinese: 模式/画质已暂存，等待重启；请选择“保存为默认”以保留。实时功能更改已排队。

english: Settings saved; feature update queued after this frame.
chinese: 设置已保存；功能更新将在本帧之后排队应用。

english: Feature update queued after this frame; defaults unchanged.
chinese: 功能更新将在本帧之后排队应用；默认值未更改。

english: NR remains unavailable; its saved request is unchanged.
chinese: NR 仍不可用；其已保存的请求保持不变。

english: Neural Rendering is not included in this build.
chinese: 本构建版本不包含神经渲染。

english: No NR runtime is available for this selection and GPU. Install the matching runtime package or select another runtime.
chinese: 此选择与 GPU 没有可用的 NR 运行时。请安装匹配的运行时包，或选择其他运行时。

english: Source NR requires DLSS or DLAA, dedicated UI Texture mode, and a configured NR runtime.
chinese: 源 NR 需要 DLSS 或 DLAA、专用 UI 纹理模式，以及已配置的 NR 运行时。

english: Source NR requested for the next eligible world frame.
chinese: 源 NR 已请求，将在下一个符合条件的世界帧生效。
源 NVIDIA 宿主不可用。

english: provider loaded without the TheosRenderPipeline control API
chinese: 提供方已加载，但缺少 TheosRenderPipeline 控制 API

english: provider rejected API v1 or returned an incomplete table
chinese: 提供方拒绝 API v1 或返回的函数表不完整
读取提供方遥测数据失败
提供方拒绝了暂存的纹理设置

english: texture settings are active but TextureDownscaler.ini could not be written
chinese: 纹理设置已生效，但无法写入 TextureDownscaler.ini
纹理设置已应用并保存

english: texture settings applied for this session
chinese: 纹理设置已应用于本次会话

english: waiting for first DXGI memory sample
chinese: 等待首个 DXGI 内存采样
DXGI 本地内存查询失败
DXGI 本地内存预算可用
